Name: Holly Holiday Crafting
Author: CaptainWolfe11
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8O4h0qZ.png[/img]
I love making wreaths from holly and I wanted to add that to the game, seeing as holly has few purposes and only three people don't dislike it!

[font=Courier New][size=6][b]What this mod adds:[/b][/size][/font]

You can now craft Holly Wreaths from 3 holly, and you'll get the recipe from Evelyn on the first day of your first winter. Its a universally liked gift and is considered an Artisan Good.

Holly can be placed in a keg to make Holly Eau De Vie, a special brandy which sells for 800 gold and takes half the time to brew as wine. It's a universally liked gift and is considered an Artisan Good.

[font=Courier New][size=6][b]Installation:
[/b][/size][/font]
This is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod. First you must download and install Content Patcher. Then, download and unzip this mod using a program like 7zip or Unarchiver. Place the unzipped folder in your Mods folder. Content Patcher will automatically load the mod into the game and you are good to go!

[font=Courier New][size=6][b]Configuration:
[/b][/size][/font]
This mod has one configuration setting - to have the wreaths and brandy match the vanilla Winter Star festival (red and gold), or to have them match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14272?tab=description]Solstice Winter Star[/url] mod's festival. You can change this setting easily using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod. Alternatively, once you install this mod and boot the game up, a config file will be generated for you in the mod folder. Open it with a text editor and change "WinterStar" to "Solstice" if you want the purple items.

[font=Courier New][size=6][b]Compatibility & Potential Issues:[/b][/size][/font]

There should be no compatibility issues, unless you have another mod that makes holly go into a keg and produce something else. Since these items are universal likes, they should work with any modded NPCs.

I have tested the mod in the game, but there's always new scenarios that might happen - please leave a comment if you encounter a bug! This is my first time making a mod that adds items or edits machines using just Content Patcher, so there was a lot of learning involved. 

Also let me know if you think this mod is unbalanced and you have recommendations :)

[font=Courier New][size=6][b]Thanks[/b][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=6][b]:[/b][/size][/font]

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild?gameId=1303]Pathoschild[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS?gameId=1303]AirynS[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14272?tab=description]Solstice Winter Star[/url], respectively. I wouldn't have been able to make this mod without all of the great documentation for Content Patcher, and I really enjoy AirynS' mod - go check it out if you haven't already!
